hints.title: Fixed Length by Unique Count
hints.text: A valid substring containing u distinct letters must have total length exactly equal to u times count.

hints.title: Iterate Unique Letter Counts
hints.text: Iterate through all possible numbers of unique characters from one to twenty-six.

hints.title: Sliding Frequency Check
hints.text: For each target length, maintain character frequencies and increment the count when all present letters meet the threshold.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(26 * N) sliding fixed windows for 1 to 26 distinct characters
variables: count: required frequency per unique letter
complexity.notes: A substring with u unique characters each appearing count times must have length u * count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every substring of all lengths takes O(N^2) which times out for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating over 1 to 26 possible unique character counts restricts search to 26 fixed window sizes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that candidate window lengths are restricted to u * count.
